verdict.rationale: QBO offers rule-based automation such as bank transaction categorization rules, automated payment reminders, and configurable workflows/custom roles, and a community source independently confirms 'automatic rules built right into QuickBooks Online' for categorization. However, evidence is thin on a general-purpose event-trigger-action rule engine (e.g., webhooks, custom conditional workflows spanning objects) beyond a few built-in automations like reminders and reconciliation reports. Missing for 10: dedicated documentation of a configurable rules/workflow engine, evidence of custom multi-condition triggers, and hands-on verification of complex automation scenarios beyond basic bank rules and reminders.
